title: edgeR functionality in edger.bp
text: package provides three test families seven test configurations. modern quasi-likelihood implementations defaults. family lower-level fitting/testing function end--end workflow: lower-level functions require design, dispersions, offsets library sizes. end--end workflows can also filter genes, calculate TMM normalization factors, estimate dispersions. Select legacy QL semantics high-level workflows qlf.args treat.args: default Treat threshold log2(1.2). Setting lfc = 0 delegates corresponding QLF test. Treat tests one coefficient one contrast; LRT QLF also support joint tests multiple coefficients contrast columns. practical starting point, use modern QLF zero-effect primary analysis, modern Treat scientific question includes minimum effect size, LRT speed exploratory sensitivity priority. Legacy QLF Treat primarily compatibility sensitivity-analysis paths. analyses, start high-level workflow: calls correspond usual native edgeR sequence constructing DGEList, filtering, normalizing, estimating dispersions, fitting GLM, testing coefficient contrast. Use lower-level functions want explicit control intermediate objects. Common reasons reuse one prepared matrix, supply dispersion vector estimated elsewhere, compare one stage directly native edgeR, avoid repeating preparation inside loop. example, high-level call: roughly equivalent : relationship holds bp_qlf() versus bp_glm_qlf(), bp_treat() versus bp_glm_treat().

what: Native edgeR and edger.bp Side by Side
title: edgeR functionality in edger.bp
text: small example runs two-group workflow native edgeR edger.bp. native edgeR workflow : corresponding high-level edger.bp calls : compact numerical comparison: comparisons package’s main correctness target: supported inputs, BPCells-backed workflow match corresponding native edgeR workflow numerical tolerance.
code: library(edgeR) library(BPCells) library(Matrix)  set.seed(48)  ngenes <- 115L nsamples <- 6L group <- factor(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 3L)) design <- model.matrix(~ group)  base_mean <- rgamma(ngenes, shape = 2, rate = 0.2) counts <- vapply(seq_len(nsamples), function(j) {     as.integer(rnbinom(ngenes, mu = base_mean, size = 4)) }, integer(ngenes))  counts[sample(length(counts), size = floor(length(counts) * 0.35))] <- 0L counts[1:3, ] <- 0L  rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", seq_len(ngenes)) colnames(counts) <- paste0("sample", seq_len(nsamples))  bp_dir <- tempfile("edger-bp-functionality-") bp_counts <- BPCells::write_matrix_dir(     BPCells::convert_matrix_type(Matrix(counts, sparse = TRUE), "uint32_t"),     dir = bp_dir ) dge <- DGEList(counts) keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design = design, group = group) dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE] dge <- normLibSizes(dge) dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design = design)  fit_lrt <- glmFit(dge, design = design) edge_lrt <- glmLRT(fit_lrt, coef = 2)  fit_ql <- glmQLFit(     dge,     design = design,     dispersion = dge$tagwise.dispersion,     legacy = FALSE ) edge_qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit_ql, coef = 2) edge_treat <- glmTreat(fit_ql, coef = 2) bp_lrt_fit <- bp_lrt(     bp_counts,     design = design,     group = group,     coef = 2,     block.size = 10L,     workers = 1L )  bp_qlf_fit <- bp_qlf(     bp_counts,     design = design,     group = group,     coef = 2,     block.size = 10L,     workers = 1L )  bp_treat_fit <- bp_treat(     bp_counts,     design = design,     group = group,     coef = 2,     block.size = 10L,     workers = 1L ) max_abs_diff <- function(x, y) {     max(abs(x - y), na.rm = TRUE) }  comparison <- data.frame(     quantity = c(         "filter keep vector",         "TMM norm factors",         "tagwise dispersion",         "LRT p-values",         "modern QLF p-values",         "modern Treat p-values"     ),     max_abs_diff = c(         max_abs_diff(as.integer(bp_lrt_fit$prepare$keep), as.integer(keep)),         max_abs_diff(bp_lrt_fit$prepare$norm.factors, dge$samples$norm.factors),         max_abs_diff(bp_lrt_fit$dispersion$tagwise.dispersion, dge$tagwise.dispersion),         max_abs_diff(bp_lrt_fit$lrt$table$PValue, edge_lrt$table$PValue),         max_abs_diff(bp_qlf_fit$qlf$table$PValue, edge_qlf$table$PValue),         max_abs_diff(bp_treat_fit$treat$table$PValue, edge_treat$table$PValue)     ) ) knitr::kable(     transform(comparison, max_abs_diff = formatC(max_abs_diff, format = "e", digits = 2)) )

Coefficients can selected index design column name: marker testing, binary one-vs-rest design multi-cluster contrast design answer related different questions: second pattern can faster many clusters QL fit can shared, changes estimand. code: bp_lrt(bp_counts, design = design, group = group, coef = "groupB")  contrast <- c("(Intercept)" = 0, "groupB" = 1) bp_lrt(bp_counts, design = design, group = group, contrast = contrast) # Binary one-vs-rest: selected cluster against all other columns pooled together. selected <- col_data$cluster == "cl01" design_binary <- model.matrix(~ selected) bp_treat(bp_counts, design = design_binary, group = selected, coef = "selectedTRUE")  # Multi-cluster contrasts: one shared model with explicit cluster contrasts. cluster <- factor(col_data$cluster) design_cluster <- model.matrix(~ 0 + cluster) contrast_cl01 <- rep(-1 / (nlevels(cluster) - 1), nlevels(cluster)) names(contrast_cl01) <- colnames(design_cluster) contrast_cl01["clustercl01"] <- 1 bp_treat(bp_counts, design = design_cluster, group = cluster, contrast = contrast_cl01)

title: Using edger.bp
text: example simulates small two-group pseudobulk experiment writes counts temporary BPCells directory. audited package versions can checked explicitly:
code: library(edger.bp) library(BPCells) library(Matrix)  set.seed(7)  ngenes <- 120L nsamples <- 8L group <- factor(rep(c("ctrl", "stim"), each = 4L))  base_mean <- rgamma(ngenes, shape = 2, rate = 0.15) fold_change <- rep(1, ngenes) fold_change[seq_len(12L)] <- 2.5  counts <- vapply(seq_len(nsamples), function(j) {     mu <- base_mean * ifelse(group[[j]] == "stim", fold_change, 1)     as.integer(rnbinom(ngenes, mu = mu, size = 8)) }, integer(ngenes))  rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", seq_len(ngenes)) colnames(counts) <- paste0("sample", seq_len(nsamples))  bp_dir <- tempfile("edger-bp-counts-") sparse_counts <- Matrix(counts, sparse = TRUE) sparse_counts <- BPCells::convert_matrix_type(sparse_counts, "uint32_t") bp_counts <- BPCells::write_matrix_dir(sparse_counts, dir = bp_dir)  design <- model.matrix(~ group) colnames(design) #> [1] "(Intercept)" "groupstim" bp_check_versions(error = FALSE) #>   package installed expected version_supported   ok     stack #> 1       R     4.5.3    4.5.3              TRUE TRUE conda-r45 #> 2   edgeR     4.8.2    4.8.2              TRUE TRUE conda-r45 #> 3   limma    3.66.0   3.66.0              TRUE TRUE conda-r45 #> 4 BPCells     0.3.1    0.3.1              TRUE TRUE conda-r45

code: bp_counts <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir("cache/counts_col") col_data <- read.delim("cache/sample_metadata.tsv")  group <- factor(col_data$condition) design <- model.matrix(~ group)  fit <- bp_treat(     bp_counts,     design = design,     group = group,     coef = "grouptreated",     block.size = 1000L,     workers = 8L )  write.table(     fit$treat$table,     file = "results/edgeR_treat.tsv",     sep = "\t",     quote = FALSE,     col.names = NA )
